text:
deploy-bot: Rolling 30% of release v1.8.3 to prod (slice-3). Monitoring canaries. :rocket:

maria: saw a spike in p99 token latency for slice-3 at +3m after rollout.

leo: confirmed, traces show kernel fallback events on gpu-pool-7, batch sizes dropping to 1.

erin: logs from the canary host: 
```
[2026-03-15T15:12:04Z] kernel_fallback: reason=unsupported_kernel path=/models/gpt-small quant=8bit
[2026-03-15T15:12:05Z] batch_window=10ms -> forced_flush due_to=latency_sla
```

oncall: paging oncall (maria) - are we seeing customer errors or just latency? :phone:

maria: no 5xx increase yet, but throughput for slice-3 is down ~40% and p95->p99 gap widened. Customers using low-latency tier might be affected.

sam: tagging CS to warn largest customers. @cs-lead can you draft a short note?

cs-lead: on it. short message: "We're investigating elevated latency on some inference routes after a recent rollout; no errors reported yet." will update if we escalate.

leo: hypothesis: new kernel selection logic in v1.8.3 sometimes prefers fallback kernels on certain checkpoint shapes. Repro on staging with same model shard?

maria: trying a targeted reproduce on staging slice-3 replica now, rerunning selection with --force-optimize.

maria: reproduce confirms kernel switch when sequence length > 1024. Patch candidate: revert kernel selector change or flip feature flag runtime.kernel_selector.v2=false.

oncall: recommend kill-switch for rollout. Does ops have a kill flag ready?

erin: feature flag exists. command to flip: `curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"runtime.kernel_selector.v2","value":false}'` (internal only).

leo: if we flip it, do we need to roll back the release? We can stop the rollout and flip flag -> expected immediate mitigation for new requests. Existing sessions may still hit fallback until recycled.

maria: agree. flip + stop rollouts, then rotate canaries.

oncall: doing flips now. @erin please confirm when done.

erin: flipped `runtime.kernel_selector.v2=false` across slice-3 and slice-4 via the feature flags API. Response: 200 OK. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by automation (user request) at 2026-03-15T15:18:32Z. Active canaries frozen.

maria: watching metrics — p99 dropping back toward baseline after ~45s. preflip p99=420ms, now ~210ms. throughput climbing.

leo: kernel fallback logs decreased to near zero on canaries. looks like selector is root cause.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-1123 (Runtime rollout: kernel-selector regression) - severity P2 - link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-1123

maria: recommendation: revert kernel selector commit in main and cut v1.8.3-postfix with the revert, then re-run canaries with selector disabled by default.

erin: ops: schedule a controlled rollback or patch release? We should avoid a full rollback if flag flip is stable.

oncall: agree — keep rollout paused, keep flag off, patch on main. I'll begin handoff to night oncall in 55m. Please document mitigation steps in the incident ticket.

sam: CS sent proactive note to affected accounts, tagging on-call if they escalate.

cs-lead: some customers asked for ETA; told them we expect a mitigation to hold and a patch tomorrow morning.

leo: adding note: root cause likely regression in kernel affinity heuristic for quantized layers when seq_len variance high. Will include a unit test to cover.

maria: thanks all. I'll update ticket with logs, graphs, and the exact flag command and rollback plan. Passing to night oncall @oncall for monitoring and potential rollback if latency reverts.

oncall: acknowledged handoff. Monitoring alerts adjusted to p99>300ms for slice-3.

incident-bot: INC-2026-1123 updated: mitigation=feature_flag_flip, next_steps=patch_revert_pr, owner=maria

maria: closing thread here, will post follow-ups in the ticket and the postmortem channel once we've patched. :memo:
